assignments.task_summary: Apply principal-scoped Wallet public reads and cross-owner canary tests across retrieval/tool context and an isolated cache test double.
Compose a prepared immutable-journal transaction scaffold with adversarial tests for dual destination, retries and bounded read-only AI.

Complete a bounded protected-payload validation/access seam using an instructor-supplied maintained AEAD adapter, while retaining safe logging checks on success, malformed input and provider exceptions.
Complete the small envelope-version/rewrapping gate in a prepared rotation harness and defend ownership, key separation and immutable business identity with the retained threat-model tests.
Measure owner-fair admission for synthetic renewal-source jobs before adding shared infrastructure; this is a local simulation, not a broker.
Complete one version-checked new-renewal command in an instructor-prepared transaction harness and account for its stage timings.
Evaluate an isolated in-memory retrieval cache keyed by principal scope, query, source/configuration/index version and expiry; transactional renewal facts stay authoritative.
Make local read-only assistance overload explicit without allowing optional AI work to starve renewal/payment command handling.
Rank read-only renewal-help configurations only after hard safety, grounding and source-currency gates.
Capture real PostgreSQL before/after query plans for owned lifecycle history using a prepared disposable fixture database.
Complete the deterministic renewal-action decision table in a prepared read harness and defend measured capacity using the original workload arithmetic.
Run the bounded cancellation/wallet/renewal journey and deterministic read-only-assistance cohort assignment using already prepared lifecycle seams.
Bind application, prompt, model configuration, retrieval/index, source dataset and evaluation versions in one local immutable release manifest.
Compare two pinned model-configuration fixtures on exact insurance source questions and mandatory abstentions, changing one variable.
Measure retrieval-empty and abstention shifts by source version/category, separating distribution signal from demonstrated answer regression.
Implement a local eligibility manifest exercise that excludes operational application, policy, wallet and support data by default; no training or transmission.
Evaluate staged source-grounded assistance metrics against pinned hard gates; recommend hold/advance/rollback without deploying.
Swap two read-only evidence adapters through public module interfaces while keeping insurance acceptance, money, cancellation and renewal logic outside generic AI utilities.
Prevent versions and chunks of one insurer wording family from leaking across training-design, validation and held-out partitions.
Execute the synthetic fetch → validate → chunk → index → publish DAG without adding a workflow service or broker.
Stage changed, added and tombstoned approved-source chunks, then atomically switch the active read version while preserving historical quote and policy evidence.
Retain Kafka offset, partition and drain semantics as an isolated CoverStory source-refresh experiment; the application path remains PostgreSQL jobs.
Evaluate answers before and after the atomic source switch without rewriting historical citations or allowing refreshed sources to mutate purchased terms.
Block defective approved-source backfills using validity, duplicate, ownership and lineage gates before publication.
Run one failed-and-recovered source pipeline slice and map evidence to the retained official AWS study direction inside the unchanged certification slot.
Compute observed downtime, recovery-point age and actual lost synthetic lifecycle IDs separately against declared fixture RTO/RPO.
Exercise an isolated dependency outage and restore-readiness gate without blindly resuming unknown provider or insurer work.
Restore a separately versioned CoverStory snapshot into a disposable PostgreSQL database and verify lifecycle, money, source and owner integrity.
Replay the locked authorized-answer and abstention fixtures against the restored CoverStory snapshot and matching release/source bundle before enabling optional help.
Switch a local assistance bundle pointer back to a verified release while retaining all application, payment, wallet and policy history.
Map three isolated outage types to truthful degraded states and bounded retries instead of one generic success/failure shortcut.
Compose existing restore, unknown-state recovery and bundle rollback checks in one bounded local demonstration with actual-evidence placeholders.
Verify read-only assistance using both before/after lifecycle state digests and attempted-write observation, including rolled-back writes.
Run held-out source-family questions once without tuning on their answers, including unsupported coverage and privacy cases.
Run one composed backend journey across submission, duplicate control, simulated insurer evidence, authorized recovery and read-only help.

Create a tamper-evident local artifact linking actual money effects, append-only transaction observations, authoritative journey steps and source citations. Treat browser analytics separately and never use it as proof of a business transition.
Package current lifecycle, AI, recovery and capacity evidence so another engineer can reproduce bounded claims from exact inputs.
Demonstrate the existing React/Spring/PostgreSQL customer flow and validate versioned wire fixtures before March UI deepening; March does not introduce the first frontend.

Audit the already established target customer journey, verify the planned TanStack Query v5/session boundary and repair at most one demonstrated integration seam. Current repository product wiring remains an instructor prerequisite, not an implemented claim.
Implement the runtime decoder used by a TanStack Query v5 queryFn before JSON enters the typed application/journey view model or shared components.
Compose shared parameterised homepage journey/application/policy cards and wire an owner-scoped TanStack query after SPA session bootstrap. Keep server state, draft state and route state separate.

Refine shared Button, Field, StatusBadge and JourneyCard compositions with finite typed variants and Tailwind tokens; apply the open-source Inter typography decision across existing mobile/desktop lifecycle screens.
Express TanStack query pending, empty, error, background-refetch and stale states explicitly while preserving safe session reset and best-effort analytics independence.
Complete the decoded owner-scoped TanStack query adapter using its cancellation signal, authenticated session scope and explicit retry policy; clear private cached state at auth boundaries.
Refine the existing exact-review form using an explicit mutation boundary, with local draft state separate from TanStack server state and all server submission gates intact.
Test duplicate interaction, mutation response loss and deliberate authoritative query invalidation without relying on button disabling or optimistic financial status for idempotency.
Keep allowlisted lifecycle status and page-size filters reproducible in URLs while excluding owner identity, answers, payment references and assistant questions.
Use owner/resource-keyed detail queries with addressable routes, preserving supported list filters and clearing stale resource/session details during navigation and refresh.

Render the authoritative timeline query through shared typed components using immutable server sequence and domain references. Preserve UNKNOWN/reconciled observations; keep best-effort analytics outside the timeline.
Apply the existing deliberate-confirmation UI skill to named recoverable mock dispatch work and pre-submission cancellation, never automatic money replay.
